name: agent-team
description: Codex coordination for a gpt-6-sol or gpt-6-astra primary with gpt-6-luna workers, an Astra critic, and an Astra UI/UX designer.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate Luna and Astra specialists in Codex.
interface.longDescription: A gpt-6-sol or gpt-6-astra primary routes bounded work to gpt-6-luna, design execution to Astra, and key tradeoffs needing Astra judgment to an independent critic; a gpt-6-astra primary may use the critic for an independent opinion without default duplicate analysis. The separate Luna-primary advisor is outside this plugin. Includes ownership-aware installation of named Codex agents.
defaultPrompt: Use $agent-team to coordinate this task with the appropriate specialists.
